title: Bigin gives no API, webhook or email alert for incoming WhatsApp messages
symptoms: Messages is absent from the v2 API
No email or Zoho Flow trigger fires on a reply
cause: Bigin's Messages channel is not exposed through the API, webhooks or Zoho Flow. The only alert is a push notification in the mobile app. Replies from existing contacts go to the contact owner, and new numbers follow the Assign Messages To rule, so a deactivated owner means nobody is told.
fix: Keep each contact's owner an active user with the mobile app installed, and set the assignment rule for new numbers.
apply: Setup > Channels > Messages > General > Assign Messages To
